Delivers: The reports page offers on-demand CSV downloads with every table column and bounded paging. ACs 1, 2, 4; 5 deferred per spec to acme/widgets#46; 4's observable half (export completes under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so paging fixes must be maintained in two places. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Blockers:
1. Email delivery is deferred without a concrete ticket, spec, or URL reference, so the deferral does not settle that scope. The spec must name a concrete follow-up reference. (doc/specs/2026-09-30-csv-export.md)

Verdict: fixable - 1 blocker

1. review - post the blocker as a comment on your PR [recommended]
2. show evidence - show CI evidence, claim and AC outcomes, and drafted payloads
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility is available), merge (email delivery lacks a valid deferral reference).

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The candidate meets every fact: it lists one numbered blocker on email delivery's missing deferral reference, treats row 5 as deferred to acme/widgets#46 without a blocker, excludes merge, posts nothing before a pick, and is decidable from the first screen with only nits and the verdict line before the menu.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The concise briefing identifies row 3 as the sole blocker, accepts row 5’s referenced deferral, and leads directly through the counts line to an actionable menu without merge or any unpicked post.
